name: Flush ceiling light
definition: Fitting fixed directly against the ceiling that lights the room from a shade or diffuser close to it.
notes: Retail category 'Flush ceiling lights', 2,966 items; sits against the ceiling, unlike pendants and chandeliers.

name: Pendant light
definition: Fitting hung from the ceiling on a cord, chain or rod, with the light source and shade below the ceiling.
notes: Retail category 'Pendant lighting' (10,323 items); IKEA pendants include multi-lamp pendants and chandeliers.

name: Chandelier
definition: Branched or tiered hanging fitting that carries several light sources, lit by electricity, gas, oil or candles.
notes: Retail category 'Chandeliers', 302 items, crystal and bulb-count versions.

name: Panel light
definition: Flat, thin ceiling fitting that gives an even sheet of light, surface-mounted or set in a grid.
notes: LEDVANCE LED panels 600x600 recessed and SMART+ Planon panels sold as LED ceiling lights.

name: Wall light (sconce)
definition: Fitting fixed to a wall that lights the room, a wall or a passage, whatever its source or fuel.
notes: Retail category 'Wall lights', 6,012 items; IKEA sells wall lamps in lamps category.

name: Mirror light
definition: Wall light made to light the face at a mirror (the lighted mirror itself is not a lamp kind).
notes: Mirror lights (Spiegelleuchten) sold as own category under Wandleuchten and Moebelleuchten, 226 to 500 products; also inside wall-light category at lights.co.uk.

name: Wall-mounted lantern light
definition: Fixed fitting in the form of a lantern, bracketed to a wall or post, not made to be carried.
notes: Litecraft outdoor lantern wall lights mounted to a wall, mains powered.

name: Recessed downlight
definition: Fitting sunk into a ceiling so that only its trim shows, casting light downward.
notes: Retail category 'Downlights', 2,057 items, mostly recessed.

name: Spot fitting
definition: Directional fitting with a swivelling head, fixed to a ceiling or a track head (the bulb of the same name is a spot bulb).
notes: Retail 'Ceiling spotlights' 4,046 items; IKEA lists spotlights separately; clamp spotlight also appears.

name: Track or rail lighting system
definition: Powered rail or cable that carries movable heads along its length, sold as a system.
notes: Retail 'Track lighting' 1,457 items: rail systems with heads, Philips Hue Perifo system.

name: Bollard or path light
definition: Low outdoor fitting standing on the ground to light a path or edge; the power source, solar included, is an attribute.
notes: Retail 'Bollard lights & pathway lights' 940 items; bollard and path light sold together.

name: Post or mast light
definition: Tall outdoor fitting on a post or mast that lights a yard, drive or area.
notes: Retail 'Lamp posts' category, 144 items.

name: Ground-spike light
definition: Outdoor fitting pushed into the soil on a spike, to light a plant, tree or wall from below.
notes: Ground spike lights sold within pathway and outdoor spotlight categories (Capelo, Tulimar, Scope).

name: Plinth light
definition: Small outdoor or step fitting set into a surface or low base to light a step, edge or wall.
notes: Recessed brick, step and under-step lights; recessed floor and pedestal lights also listed; the word plinth is absent from the pages.

name: Floodlight
definition: Wide-beam outdoor or area fitting fixed on a wall, post or ground bracket, including the light-only security floodlight and the searchlight.
notes: Outdoor LED wall flood light with adjustable head; floodlights also linked on lights.co.uk outdoor menu.

name: Stage lighting fixture
definition: Fixture rigged on a truss, bar or stand to light a stage or event; fixture types stay named forms until a catalogue compares them separately.
notes: Ellipsoidal spotlights and LED par cans sold as stage lighting; moving heads from Clay Paky; fixture types not separated.

name: Table lamp
definition: Lamp with a base and a fixed shade or head that stands on a table; oil, gas and candle table lamps are this kind with a fuel tag.
notes: Retail category 'Table lamps', 5,041 items.

name: Desk lamp
definition: Lamp with an adjustable arm or head made for task light, standing or clamped; a clip-on desk lamp is this kind with a clamp installation attribute.
notes: Anglepoise Type 75 sold as desk lamp; IKEA lists work lamps and LED desk lamps.

name: Night light
definition: Small low-output lamp that plugs in or stands to give dim light overnight; baby use is a user tag.
notes: Encyclopedia entry and shop categories: small low-light fixtures for children, plug-in, wall, table-top, LED, touch-sensor types.

name: Sunrise lamp
definition: Bedside lamp that brightens gradually to wake the sleeper, with or without a radio.
notes: Sunrise alarm clocks: Hatch Restore, Philips Sunrise Alarm Clock; page notes some are not strictly lamps.

name: Floor lamp
definition: Tall lamp on a base that stands on the floor beside furniture, with a shade or head near head height.
notes: Retail category 'Floor lamps', 2,424 items.

name: Floor uplighter
definition: Floor-standing lamp whose light is thrown upward to the ceiling.
notes: Torchiere floor lamps that direct light upward, sold as a floor-lamp subcategory.

name: Handheld flashlight
definition: Hand torch from pocket size to duty size; output class, cell, beam and water or depth rating (a dive light included) are attributes, and EDC and tactical are scene tags.
notes: Streamlight and Maglite handheld flashlights; shop also has 'Handheld Flashlights' category.

name: Penlight
definition: Slim pen-shaped hand light for close work or inspection.
notes: Streamlight Stylus Pro penlight; Gregg category 'Penlights and Inspection Lights'; Olight O-Pen.

name: Keychain light
definition: Very small light made to hang from a key ring.
notes: Olight i3E Keychain Flashlights; Gregg category 'Clip and Keychain Flashlights'.

name: Clip-on light
definition: Small light with a clip made to attach to a cap, pocket, strap or bag.
notes: Streamlight ClipMate clip-on LED flashlight; Olight Oclip clip light.

name: Handheld searchlight
definition: Large-head or pistol-grip hand spotlight, a form apart from the cylindrical torch.
notes: Streamlight Waypoint handheld pistol-grip spotlight with parabolic reflector, sold as spotlight.

name: Headlamp
definition: Light worn on the head on a band or cap mount, also called a head torch; running, ultralight and caving versions are named forms or an attribute.
notes: Streamlight Septor and Trident headlamps; Petzl headlamp range; Gregg lists headlamps and helmet lights.

name: Electric lantern
definition: Carried lantern lit by a battery, rechargeable cell or solar panel; the power source is an attribute.
notes: Streamlight Vulcan LED Lantern and LiteBox rechargeable lantern; Olight Olantern.

name: Mantle fuel lantern
definition: Carried lantern in which a gas or liquid fuel heats a mantle to give light (propane, liquid fuel, dual fuel).
notes: Coleman, Petromax and Vapalux pressure lanterns burning fuel through mantles.

name: Hurricane lantern
definition: Carried lantern with a wick, a fuel reservoir and a tubular glass globe, burning oil.
notes: Dietz hot- and cold-blast tubular kerosene lanterns; hurricane lantern defined as portable flat-wick lamp.

name: Candle lantern
definition: Enclosed lantern with a handle that holds a candle, made to be carried.
notes: UCO Original Candle Lantern: spring-fed candle tube, steel bail for hanging; collapsible.

name: Paper lantern [chochin]
definition: Collapsible or rigid paper-covered lantern made to be carried as a light; one made to hang as decoration is not a lamp kind.
notes: Collapsible portable chochin lit by battery lights; Suifu chochin folding paper lanterns.

name: Clamp work light
definition: Portable work light with a guard and hook, clamped or hung at the job, sold as work or commercial lighting.
notes: Southwire clamp light with 8.5 in reflector, sold under temporary handheld lighting.

name: Trouble (inspection) light
definition: Portable corded or cordless light on a hook or handle for inspecting dark spaces such as engine bays and crawl spaces.
notes: Trouble light: caged bulb in handle, long cord, also called drop light or inspection lamp.

name: General-service bulb
definition: Pear-shaped (A-shape, GLS) bulb for ordinary lamps and fittings; filament style is an attribute and a smart bulb is this kind with a connectivity attribute.
notes: Filament and A60 E27 LED bulbs, smart bulbs; shape given by filters.

name: Candle bulb
definition: Slim bulb in the shape of a candle flame, for chandeliers and small fittings.
notes: C35 candle and teardrop E14 LED bulbs listed.

name: Globe bulb
definition: Round, ball-shaped bulb.
notes: G95 and G125 globe LED bulbs, B22 and E27; PriceSpy category 'globe light bulbs'.

name: Reflector bulb
definition: Bulb with a built-in reflector that throws the light forward (R, BR and PAR shapes).
notes: Reflector LED GU10 and PAR16 bulbs listed.

name: Spot bulb
definition: Small directional bulb for spot fittings, with pin or twist-lock caps (GU10, GU5.3 and MR16 types); the fitting of the same name is a spot fitting.
notes: GU10 and GU5.3/MR16 spot bulbs; base families linked on page.

name: Capsule bulb
definition: Very small bulb with a pin cap, for low-voltage lamps and small fittings (G4 and G9 types).
notes: G9 bi-pin capsule LED bulbs and G4 base link listed.

name: Linear tube lamp
definition: Long straight tube light source with its own cap and holder; fluorescent, LED and halogen versions are one kind and technology is an attribute.
notes: LED tubes G13 T8 and G5 T5 (119 items); fluorescent tubes category also linked.

name: Compact fluorescent lamp
definition: Folded or coiled fluorescent source, of the pin-base types that need their own holder.
notes: Compact fluorescent lights 33 items in pin bases 2G11, G23, G24, GX24q (Dulux, Master PL).

name: High-intensity discharge lamp
definition: Discharge source that needs a ballast and cannot be swapped for another source.
notes: Gas discharge lamps 51 items: sodium, metal halide, CDM ceramic discharge.

name: Strip light
definition: Flexible strip of light sources sold to light a space (under-cabinet, cove); technology is an attribute.
notes: LED strips category 398 items; strips with profiles, controllers, RGB and tunable white.

name: Lamp shade
definition: Shade made to be fitted to a lamp or fitting.
notes: Retail 'Lamp shades' 185 items; IKEA 'Shades, bases & cords'.

name: Lamp base
definition: Base or stand sold alone to carry a lamp.
notes: IKEA lamps subcategory 'Shades, bases & cords' sells bases.

name: Lamp cord set
definition: Cord with a plug and switch or socket made for a lamp; a pendant cord set is this kind with fits set to pendant.
notes: IKEA lamps subcategory 'Shades, bases & cords' sells cord sets.

name: Lamp holder or socket
definition: Holder or socket that carries a light source in a lamp or fitting.
notes: Lampholders in BC/B22, SBC/B15, ES/E27, SES/E14 and halogen types, with shade rings.

name: Chandelier crystal or glass diffuser
definition: Crystal drop or glass diffuser made to be fitted to a chandelier or fitting.
notes: Seller guide to chandelier prisms and pendalogues: clear, colored, lead crystal, rock crystal; crystals fit chandeliers and lamps.
